description: This file defines a React functional component for displaying and editing agent information within a dashboard interface. It manages fetching agent details, displaying overview data, and providing an administrative interface to modify agent settings.

methods.name: AgentInfoView
methods.description: React functional component that displays detailed information about a specific agent, including overview and settings. Supports viewing, editing, and saving agent configurations with admin privileges.

methods.name: fetchMetadata
methods.description: Fetches agent creation metadata asynchronously and updates component state.

methods.name: fetchAgentInfo
methods.description: Retrieves agent information based on agentId and accessToken, updates state, and sets form values accordingly.

methods.name: handleUpdate
methods.description: Handles form submission for updating agent information, including data transformation and API calls.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Helper function to format date strings into a human-readable format.
